name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-copilot-components-zava-procurement-command-center
title: ZavaCore Procurement Command Center
shortDescription: Guided intake, human approvals, resilient sourcing and global investment insights in 22 Copilot experiences.
longDescription: ZavaCore Procurement Command Center connects natural-language business cases to human review, supplier deal evaluation, governed awards, global investment maps, delivery progress and verified procurement value.

Twenty-one operational components and one capability explorer continue into My Requests, Sourcing Workbench, Supplier 360, and Spend Command. The connected rugged-device story preserves request, event, supplier, policy, award, invoice, and value context across roles.

The sample is deterministic, offline, responsive, and explicit that confirmed actions are session-only demonstrations. D3-derived decision visuals include keyboard interaction, accessible summaries, and exact-value alternatives.
